semantic.justification: Original abstract EditUndo captures unsigned16 ID, actual engine pointer and current active view-shell identity or minus-one default, rejects repeat and returns original owned OUString comment or empty owned value. Actual existing SfxUndoAction inheritance is retained with an erased comment-value type parameter; source parameterless Undo/Redo bind existing context entry points. No source comment conversion, default shell, label provider or manager is introduced. Consumed OutlinerViewShell declaration has no implementation. Original EditUndoManager selects the shared native-labelled SfxUndoManager storage specialization for recording and clearing. Active-view undo and redo execution, physical ABI and full source undo QA remain outside this checkpoint.
